name: firefly
description: Adobe Firefly MCP server with 14 tools for images, Image 5 edits, video, upscaling, composites and custom models.
long_description: Requires Adobe Firefly Services API access with OAuth Server-to-Server credentials. Generation consumes Adobe credits. Credentials are supplied locally, never bundled. The same tools are available through firefly-cli. Read-only hides generation and uploads.

client_id.title: Firefly Services client ID
client_id.description: OAuth Server-to-Server client ID from your Adobe Developer Console project.

client_secret.title: Firefly Services client secret
client_secret.description: OAuth Server-to-Server client secret. Never your Adobe account password.

output_dir.title: Optional output folder
output_dir.description: Folder on this computer used when download=true. Leave empty for ~/outputs/images.

read_only.title: Read only
read_only.description: Hide generation and upload tools. Existing jobs and custom models can still be read.
